init.title: iDotMatrix options
init.description:
Home Assistant normally connects through the proxy with the strongest signal, but the strongest one can be unreliable. Pin a specific proxy if needed.

Colour correction: the panel's LEDs are near-linear while images are sRGB, and its blue LEDs are much brighter than its red ones — so uncorrected output looks washed out and blue. Gamma 2.2 fixes the first, the white-balance gains fix the second. Set all gains to 1.0 and gamma to 1.0 for raw, uncorrected output.
